This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 4" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|pale yellowish]] skin, with partially red faces, as well as a single strip of long dark hair extending from the tops of their heads.<ref name="Chapter 4" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|4}}</ref> one member of this species was present in a [[Sorgan Common House|common house]] on the [[planet]] [[Sorgan]].<ref name="Chapter 4">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 4: Sanctuary}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 4: Sanctuary|fourth episode]] of the [[2019]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''.<ref name="Chapter 4" />
